name: Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Limited
about: Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Limited engages in the food processing and engineering businesses in India. The company offers wheat flour and wheat products, including chakki ata, maida, roasted sooji, vermicelli, and ada under the Kuthuvilakku brand name to commercial establishments and households. It also provides rotors, mounting brackets, and steering boxes to automotive industry; manifolds, crank cases, and PTO covers to agriculture industry; and coffee pulpers, textile machine parts, and pump casing to other industries. In addition, it offers control panel boxes, textile machineries, textile testing and sorting products, coffee plantation machineries, flour milling machineries, wagon rails, flood light fittings, bucket elevators, and material handling equipment; and custom design and prototyping, as well as powder coating services. Further, it is involved in wind power generation. The company was formerly known as KLRF Limited and changed its name to Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Limited in May 2018. Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
